nodes.label: .`any signed-in operator can clear a command awaiting reconciliation, and it is recorded first`()
.`clearing a damaged outbox entry keeps its raw bytes in the record`()
.`a clear that cannot be recorded removes nothing`()
.`nobody signed in, an unknown id, or a command still recoverable here is not cleared`()
.`only the signed-in operator's commands from earlier sessions are recovered`()
.`with nobody signed in nothing is sent`()
.`another operator signing in does not inherit earlier notices`()
.`a recovery that throws becomes a notice and the next command is still recovered`()
